title: Frump's Amazing Relic
description: Frump's Amazing Relic — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Tilles the Sellout

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Collect 1 Amazing Red Stapler Relic Autographed by Frump from within Frump's Misfortune and return to Tilles the Sellout.

Quest Reward: 20 King's Coins

Return to: Tilles the Sellout

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Frump's Misfortune (quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Collect 1 Amazing Red Stapler Relic Autographed by Frump from within Frump's Misfortune and return to Tilles the Sellout.

Offer:

Private Buyer Looking for an Amazing Relic!
WANTED: 1 Amazing Red Stapler Relic Autographed by Frump. I just want something that The Frump used to own. Contact Tilles the Sellout for more info.

Turn-in:

You have a knack for finding these Relics. I'll contact the person who posted the ad on your behalf.

Objectives:

  • Frump's Amazing Relic ×1

Client level range: 25–50
